verdict.rationale: Exa offers an agentic product (Exa Agent) whose tool loop could plausibly accept user-supplied MCP servers, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Exa acting as an MCP client. The Exa MCP Server exposes Exa's own tools to other assistants, which is the server role, and Exa Connect attaches premium data partners rather than arbitrary MCP servers; neither counts toward this story.
